name: Gizmo for Warug
objectiveText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring an Advanced Target Dummy to Warug in the Magram Village in Desolace . Advanced Target Dummy  ( 1 )   Magram Clan Centaur  ( Friendly )

comments.body:
...Really. Warug asks for some stupid thing only skilled Engineers can make. I got mine by spamming the Trade Chat, and when I saw that after giving him the damned thing, he wanted me to kill some Khan, I just stopped. Sure I dd the next one but geez, what a lazy bum :D.
    If you want to stop here in this chain, it would be sensible. However, after leaving the Magram I saw that I had to go to STV. I didn't want to, so I clicked 'At War' on the Magram Rep Bar and turned around and started killing them.
    [b]I highly reccomend stopping here and turning traitor to helping the Gelkis. Take the Nijel's quest and the Gelkis quest chain, and you got yourself a good two more levels out of Desolace.[/b]

I'm happy to make these for people at no charge, providing they send the mats.

I play on Dunemaul as Gringel (alliance).

The mats list, for reference, are as follows:

four heavy leather
three iron bars
two bronze bars
one gold bar
one medium leather
one wool cloth

Looking at your local AH (That is were I ended up getting mine) or you can find and engineer with skill 185 or higher and have them make it for you.  You can find the needed items to make it at the AH also.  If you are a member of a guild, ask someone to help you, or if not, use the general chat area to ask for help in making it.  Good look.
The easiest way to do this is find a engineer...

As everyone is getting exited about Target Dummies can I point out that these will never seriously feature on the AH as you have to be an engineer to use them.  If you are an engineer you can make them so why would you go to the AH to buy them!  My alt has engineering but I dont put these on AH because they have no market. ( I am not enthusiastic about repeatedly losing my deposit).  The hard word is - that this is a breeze for engineers or someone with a good guild profession organisation behind them.  I suggest everyone else should consider abandoning the quest as it is not worth the effort.

This has to go into my worst quest of all time notebook. I spent a few hours killing enough Gelkis clan centaur to get my reputation with the Magram to friendly, then got the Gizmo for Warug quest. By the time a friend made the advanced target dummy for me, my reputation with the Magram had changed back to neutral. I went back to mercilessly slay what must have been five-hundred Gelkis clan centaur (I'm not exaggerating here - I wiped all of them out from the cave to the camps at the top of the ridge about three times) only to get my reputation halfway through neutral before I gave up due to sheer boredom. This quest must be broken, if not it is the biggest waste of time you could ever imagine.
